entry.title: Ghana commits to train 100,000 TVET facilitators in AI under new UNESCO and Microsoft partnership
entry.summary:
Isikhungo sase-Ghana Sokufundisa Ngobuchwepheshe Nemisebenzi (TVET) sisayine isivumelwano ne-UNESCO, i-KPMG ne-Microsoft ngomhla zingama-30 kuMandulo 2026, ukufundisa okungenani othisha bakwa-TVET abayizinkulungwane ezilikhulu kwi-AI nekhono ledijithali ngaphansi kohlelo i-AI EmpowerED. Umphathi we-TVET Service, uDkt Eric Kofi Adzroe, uthe lobu bambiswano buveza uguquko oluya kuhlelo elihambisana nembonakalo yeziko, eliqhutshwa ubuchwepheshe futhi ligxile kumiphumela, kanti ummeleli we-UNESCO e-Ghana, uEdmond Moukala, usayine isivumelwano egameni lenhlangano.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Ngokuqondene nensika 4 ka-Wits AHEAD, ikhono labathweswe iziqu, ukuqasheka kanye noguquko olunobulungiswa, ukuhlomisa othisha bakwa-TVET ngamakhono e-AI ngesilinganiso esinje kungaguqula indlela isizukulwane sonke sababazi nabasebenzi bobuchwepheshe base-Afrika engena ngayo emakethe yemisebenzi esiguqulwe i-AI, isibonelo i-Wits AHEAD esilandela ukuthola izifundo ezisebenza emkhakhani wase-South Africa we-TVET.

Graphic Online · National press, government partnership announcement

entry.title: US learning platform data shows AI tools trail far behind other classroom technology
entry.summary:
Umbiko omusha we-EdTech Top 40 we-Instructure, osekelwe kudatha engenamagama yabasebenzisi abayizigidi ezingu-19.5 benkundla yokufunda ye-Canvas phakathi kukaMandulo 2025 noMbasa 2026, uthole ukuthi i-Google Gemini, ithuluzi le-AI elisetshenziswa kakhulu, lifinyelele kuphela kubasebenzisi abangu-87,788 ezikhungweni ezingu-211, futhi alifinyelelanga nakwizindawo ezingu-100 eziphezulu zamathuluzi ahlanganisiwe. Amathuluzi asezinzile njengo-McGraw Hill, onabasebenzisi abayizigidi ezingu-11.3, kanye nokuhlolwa kwezifundo kwe-Watermark ne-Zoom, asalokhu esetshenziswa kakhulu kunakho konke. Isekela likamongameli we-Instructure, uRyan Lufkin, uthe amanyuvesi asayina izivumelwano ze-AI ezimboza yonke inyuvesi kodwa engakayifaki le mithuluzi ezifundweni zansuku zonke.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Ngokuqondene nensika 1 ka-Wits AHEAD, i-AI ekhiqizayo kwimfundo ephakeme, igebe eliphakathi kwamalayisense e-AI athengwa izikhungo nokusetshenziswa kwangempela ekilasini yisexwayiso i-Wits AHEAD esiyilandelayo eduze: ukuthenga ukufinyelela emathuluzini e-AI akufani nokuwafaka ekufundiseni nasekuhloleni, okuxhumana ngqo nomsebenzi weqembu mayelana nokusetshenziswa okungokoqobo.

Inside Higher Ed · Established press report on industry usage data

entry.title: UNESCO programme trains over 100 rural teachers and principals across China and Southeast Asia in AI and STEM
entry.summary:
I-UNESCO ibike ngomhla zingama-30 kuMandulo 2026 ukuthi uHlelo Lwayo Lokuthuthukisa Amakhono Othisha Nabaphathi e-China ne-Southeast Asia, olubanjwe eBeijing kusukela zi-17 kuya zi-23 kuNcwaba 2026 ngaphansi kwesihloko esithi 'I-STEM ne-AI: Ukunika Amandla Othisha Basemakhaya Ngoguquko Ledijithali', luhlanganise abenzi bezinqubomgomo zemfundo abangaphezu kwekhulu, abaphathi bezikole, othisha kanye nochwepheshe abavela e-China nasemazweni ase-Southeast Asia. Luhlelwe ndawonye ne-International Research and Training Centre for Rural Education ye-UNESCO, i-SEAMEO RECSAM, iSihlalo se-UNESCO Sobuhlakani Bokwenziwa Kwimfundo e-Beijing Normal University kanye ne-OECD, uhlelo belugxile ekusebenziseni i-AI nokufundisa i-STEM ukuthuthukisa ukulingana kwedijithali emiphakathini yasemakhaya engaphathwa ngokwanele. USolwazi Shahbaz Khan, umqondisi we-Hhovisi Lesifunda le-UNESCO le-East Asia, ubize i-AI 'egxile emuntwini, enokuzimela ngokokuziphatha futhi ebandakanya bonke' kwimfundo.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Ngokuqondene nensika 3 ka-Wits AHEAD, i-AI nokuhlaziywa kwedatha kwi-STEM nemfundo yothisha, ukugcizelela kohlelo ukuthi ubuchwepheshe bungasekela kodwa bungasoze bathatha indawo yothisha basemakhaya kunikeza isibonelo i-Wits AHEAD engasisebenzisa emsebenzini wayo wokulungiselela abafundisi bothisha ezingxenyeni ezingaphathwa ngokwanele zamazwe aseNingizimu Yomhlaba.

UNESCO · Intergovernmental body

entry.title: Ethiopia's Education Ministry says AI will support, not replace, teachers as it expands digital learning
entry.summary:
UNgqongqoshe Wezemfundo wase-Ethiopia, uBerhanu Nega, uthe ngomhla zingama-29 kuMandulo 2026 ukuthi othisha ezweni lonke basekelwa ukusebenzisa ubuhlakani bokwenziwa ekulungiseleleni izifundo, ukuthuthukisa okuqukethwe, ukusekela abafundi kanye nokuhlola, kanye nokudijithalaywa kwezinhlelo zolwazi lokuphathwa kwemfundo neyemfundo ephakeme yomnyango. UNgqongqoshe ugcizelele ukuthi i-AI yethulwa ukuqinisa amakhono othisha, hhayi ukubathatha isikhundla, njengengxenye yomkhankaso obanzi wokufunda okuku-inthanethi, okuxubile kanye nezincwadi ezincane, kanye nokuxhumana kwedijithali okuqinile emanyuvesini nasezikoleni. Ucele ukuthi uhlelo lwemfundo ludlule ekugcineni ngekhanda kuphela futhi lithuthukise abacabanga ngokugxekayo abangasebenza 'ndawonye nemishini'.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Ngokuqondene nensika 1 ka-Wits AHEAD, i-AI ekhiqizayo kwimfundo ephakeme, kanye nensika 5, ukuhlaziywa kwedatha kwizinhlelo zemfundo, umnyango wikazwelonke ozibophezela obala ukuthi i-AI isekela othisha esikhundleni sokubathatha indawo, kanye noguquko ngesevisi yedatha, yisibonakaliso senqubomgomo i-Wits AHEAD esiyilandelayo kulo lonke elamazwe aseNingizimu Yomhlaba.

allAfrica (Ethiopian News Agency) · National press, government ministry announcement

entry.title: Africa must build its own AI solutions rather than import them, says UN scientific panel member
entry.summary:
UGirmaw Abebe Tadesse, oholela i-AI for Good Lab ye-Microsoft e-Kenya futhi angxenye ye-Independent International Scientific Panel ye-United Nations Yobuhlakani Bokwenziwa, utshele i-UN News ngesikhathi se-UN High Level Week eNew York ngomhla zingama-25 kuMandulo 2026 ukuthi amazwe ase-Afrika kufanele achaze izinkinga zawo siqu ngaphambi kokwamukela ubuchwepheshe obuklanywe kwenye indawo. Uthe ababambiqhaza, kuhlanganise izikhungo zemfundo ephakeme, ohulumeni, abalingani bentuthuko kanye nezinkampani zobuchwepheshe, kufanele bahlanganise ulwazi ukwakha izixazululo ezifanele izimo zendawo kunokuphinda okwenziwe kakade, futhi waphawula ukuthi abantu abasha base-Afrika sebevele beyisidingida sokusungula, sebesebenzisa ubuchwepheshe ezinkingeni zemiphakathi.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Ngokuqondene nensika 6 ka-Wits AHEAD, i-AI enokuzibophezela, ukuziphatha okulungile, ukulingana nenqubomgomo, umeluleki wesayensi we-United Nations obiza obala amanyuvesi njengabalingani ababalulekile ohlelweni lwe-AI oluholwa yindawo uqinisa isizathu se-Wits AHEAD sokugcizelela ucwaningo nezixazululo zase-Afrika, hhayi izinhlaka ezingenisiwe.

allAfrica (UN News) · UN News Service, intergovernmental body

entry.title: Cape Town hosts first African THE World Academic Summit as Wits and four other South African universities rise in the world rankings
entry.summary:
Ingqungquthela Yezemfundo Ephakeme Yomhlaba ye-Times Higher Education (THE) ivulwe e-University of Cape Town ngomhla zingama-30 kuMandulo 2026, okuwukuqala kwalo mcimbi ukubanjwa e-Afrika, kuhambisana nokwethulwa kohlu lwe-THE World University Rankings 2027. Manje amanyuvesi ayisihlanu aseNingizimu Afrika asezingeni lezingama-500 eziphambili emhlabeni, kuhlanganise ne-Wits esesikhundleni sango-301 kuya ku-325. I-University of Cape Town yenyukele esikhundleni sama-147 kanye nenye iyunivesithi, okuyisikhundla sayo esihle kakhulu eminyakeni eyisikhombisa. USekela-Shansela we-University of Cape Town, uMosa Moshabela, uthe inyuvesi yakhe icishe amathuluzi okuthola i-AI, igxile kunalokho ekufundiseni abafundi ukusebenzisa i-AI ngendlela efanele, kanti uNgqongqoshe Wezemfundo Ephakeme, uButi Manamela, uphawule ukuthi kwabantu abasha abayishumi baseNingizimu Afrika, abayisithupha abangasebenzi.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Ngokuqondene nensika 1 ka-Wits AHEAD, okuyi-AI ekhiqizayo kwimfundo ephakeme, isinqumo se-University of Cape Town sokuyeka ukusebenzisa amathuluzi okuthola i-AI, sikhethe kunalokho ukufundisa ukuyisebenzisa ngendlela efanele, siwuguquko enqubomgomeni yokuhlola i-Wits AHEAD esiyilandelayo kulo lonke elomkhakha wezemfundo ephakeme; ukukhuphuka kohlu lwamazinga kanye nenani lokungasebenzi elishiwo uNgqongqoshe kugcizelela ukuthi kungani i-AI, ukuhlaziywa kwedatha nekhono labathweswe iziqu kubalulekile kuwo wonke amanyuvesi aseNingizimu Afrika, kuhlanganise ne-Wits.

Daily Maverick · Established press

entry.title: Alliance for African Partnership meets in Dar es Salaam and puts AI skills at the centre of regional cooperation

category.term: Africa (Tanzania, hosted by the University of Dar es Salaam)

entry.summary:
I-Alliance for African Partnership, inhlangano yamanyuvesi angu-12 avela emazweni angu-10 base-Afrika eyesekelwe yi-Michigan State University, ibambe umhlangano wayo wonyaka wezi-2026 e-University of Dar es Salaam kusukela ngo-16 kuya ku-22 kuMandulo. Isekela likaShansela elibhekene Nocwaningo uNelson Boniface utshele izithunywa ukuthi amanyuvesi kumele abuyekeze uhlelo lwezifundo futhi aqeqeshe othisha ukuze abathweswe iziqu bangasali ngemuva ngenxa yobuhlakani bokwenziwa (i-AI), wanezela ngokuthi ukwazi ukusebenzisa i-AI manje sekuyikhono okudingeka kubo bonke abafundi, hhayi kuphela kwabesayensi yekhompyutha.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Ngokuqondene nensika 4, ikhono labathweswe iziqu, ukuqasheka kanye nokuguqulwa okunobulungiswa, isibizo se-Alliance sokuguqula uhlelo lwezifundo nokuqeqesha othisha emazweni angu-10 ase-Afrika sivumelana nombono ka-Wits AHEAD wokufaka ukwazi i-AI kuzo zonke izifundo, hhayi kuphela kwe-STEM, ukuze abathweswe iziqu base-Afrika baqhubeke beqashekile.

allAfrica.com, from the Daily News (Tanzania) · Established African news service

entry.title: Morgan State University wins 10 million dollar federal grant to build a trusted AI research institute
entry.summary:
I-Morgan State University, inyuvesi enomlando wabantu abaMnyama eBaltimore, ithole u-10 million wamadola kusukela kuhulumeni wase-United States ukuze isungule i-Institute for Trusted Autonomous Networks, ebizwa nge-TITAN, kanti lokhu kumenyezelwe osomthetho baseMelika uChris Van Hollen no-Angela Alsobrooks ngomhla ziyi-16 kuMandulo 2026. Lolu xhaso lweminyaka emihlanu luxhasa ucwaningo kanye nokuqeqeshwa kwabafundi be-PhD kwezobuhlakani bokwenziwa (i-AI), ukuphepha kwezobuchwepheshe kanye nokuphepha okuthuthukiswe nge-quantum, futhi luhloswe ukusiza i-Morgan State ukuba ifinyelele izinga eliphezulu kakhulu emanyuvesi ocwaningo aseMelika.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Ngokuqondene nensika yesi-3, i-AI kanye nokuhlaziywa kwedatha kwezifundo ze-STEM nasekuqeqeshweni kothisha, ukugxila kwe-TITAN ekuqeqesheni abacwaningi be-PhD enyuvesini enomlando wabantu abaMnyama kubonisa indlela uxhaso oluqondiswe locwaningo lwe-AI olungakwazi ukwandisa ngayo ukuthi ubani oholayo kulolu cwaningo, okuwumbuzo iWits AHEAD ewulandelayo mayelana nokulingana kwe-STEM emhlabeni wonke.

CBS News Baltimore · Established press

entry.title: MIT trains faculty from other universities to teach AI across disciplines
entry.summary:
I-Stephen A. Schwarzman College of Computing yase-MIT ihlolisise ishopi eliyisonto elilodwa elifundisa othisha bezinye izikhungo ukuba bafundise ubuhlakani bokwenziwa nokufunda komshini ngaphakathi kwezifundo zabo, kususela ezinsizeni ze-kosi ye-MIT ethi 'Modelling with Machine Learning'. Ishopi lokuqala ngoJulayi 2026 lahlanganisa abafundisi abangu-19 abavela ezikhungweni eziyisikhombisa, okuhlanganisa i-Allen University, i-Babson College, i-Brandeis University kanye ne-University of Massachusetts Lowell, kufundiswa abafundisi be-MIT abangaphezu kwesithupha ngezindaba zezimali, isayensi yamakhompuyutha nokusimama.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Kwensika 3, i-AI nokuhlaziywa kwedatha ku-STEM nasekufundeni othisha, leli shopi lixazulula inkinga iWits AHEAD nayo ebhekene nayo: othisha abangaphandle kwesayensi yamakhompuyutha badinga uqeqesho lwangempela ngaphambi kokuba bakwazi ukufundisa ngokuthembekile ukwazi nge-AI ngaphakathi kwezifundo zabo.

MIT News · University announcement

entry.title: UNESCO survey finds most Latin American and Caribbean universities use AI, but few have a strategy
entry.summary:
I-International Institute for Higher Education in Latin America and the Caribbean (IESALC) ye-UNESCO, ibambisene ne-United Nations University Institute for the Advanced Study of Sustainability, ihlole izikhungo zemfundo ephakeme ezingu-200 emazweni angu-19 futhi yashicilela imiphumela yayo ngo-8 Septhemba 2026, ngesikhathi se-Digital Learning Week ye-UNESCO. Kutholakele ukuthi amaphesenti angu-87 ezikhungo asesebenzisa i-AI kungenani engxenyeni eyodwa yomsebenzi wazo, ikakhulukazi ekufundiseni, kodwa amaphesenti angu-26 kuphela anohlelo lwe-AI olusemthethweni. Iningi lezinhlelo ze-AI liqala kothisha, kubacwaningi noma kubafundi ngokwabo, hhayi kubaholi bezikhungo.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Kwensika 6, i-AI enokuzibophezela, ukuziphatha okuhle, ubulungisa nenqubomgomo, lo mgamu phakathi kokusetshenziswa kwe-AI okucishe kufike kuwo wonke amazwe kanye nokubusa okusemthethweni okuncane e-Latin America nase-Caribbean ufana nephethini iWits AHEAD eyibhekayo kulo lonke elaseNingizimu Yomhlaba, lapho umkhuba wansuku zonke ugijima phambi kwenqubomgomo yezikhungo.

UNESCO IESALC and United Nations University · Intergovernmental higher education body report

entry.title: University of Colorado system adopts a living policy for responsible use of AI
entry.summary:
Inqubomgomo entsha yesimiso sokuphathwa 6012 yesistimu yaseNyuvesi yaseColorado, ethi Ukusetshenziswa Okunesibopho Kobuhlakani Bokwenziwa, isiqale ukusebenza ngomhla ka-24 Agasti 2026 futhi yaphakanyiswa kubhulogi yenqubomgomo yenyuvesi ngomhla ka-21 Septhemba. Ibeka izilindelo kusistimu yonke mayelana nobuqotho basemfundweni, ukuvikeleka kwedatha, ukusobala kanye nokuhlola ukuchaneka kokuqukethwe okukhiqizwe i-AI, futhi ibekwa ngokusobala njengenqubomgomo ehlose ukuguquka njengoba impendulo ivela kubafundi nabasebenzi.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Kwensika 1, i-AI ekhiqizayo kwimfundo ephakeme, ukufundisa, ukuhlola kanye nobuqotho, isistimu enkulu yenyuvesi kahulumeni ekhethe ukuphatha imithetho yayo ye-AI njengombhalo ophilayo esikhundleni senqubomgomo emile, kunika iWits AHEAD isilinganiso esivela eNyakatho Yomhlaba yezinqumo zokubusa ezilandelayo eNingizimu Yomhlaba.

University of Colorado · University policy announcement

entry.title: University of Pretoria trains future teachers in "prompt literacy" for the AI classroom
entry.summary:
Abacwaningi eMnyangweni Wezemfundo Yezingane Ezincane eNyuvesi yasePretoria, abaholwa nguDkt Joyce West noDkt Kayla Willemse, benza ucwaningo olunezigaba eziningi mayelana nokufunda ukubhala imiyalo ku-AI, okuwukukwazi ukunika i-AI ekhiqizayo imiyalo ecacile kanti futhi uhlole ngeso elibukhali lokho ekukhiqizayo. Uphrojekthi ifundisa othisha bakusasa ukusebenzisa i-AI njengethuluzi lasekilasini elibambisene, hhayi njengengozi, ngemisebenzi efana nokwakha izindaba zezingane nezinsiza ezidijithali, kuyilapho begadile khona ukukhethelela, amaphutha, kanye namalungelo obunikazi kulokho i-AI ekukhiqizayo.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Kwensika 3, ukuhlaziywa kwe-AI kwi-STEM nasemfundweni yothisha, lolu cwaningo lubhekana negebe iWits AHEAD elilandela ngokucophelela: ukuthi othisha abasha bayafundiswa ngempela ukubuza imibuzo ngalokho i-AI ekukhiqizayo, hhayi nje ukukukhiqiza.

Future SA, reporting University of Pretoria research · South African higher education press, reporting university research

entry.title: East African universities and Arizona State University partner to build "AI-ready" higher education
entry.summary:
I-Inter-University Council for East Africa, inhlangano yemfundo ephakeme ye-East African Community, imemezele ngo-9 Septhemba 2026 ubambiswano ne-University Design Institute yase-Arizona State University ukusiza amanyuvesi ase-East Africa ukuba alungele i-AI. Lo msebenzi umbandakanya izigaba ezine: ubuholi nokubusa, ukuthuthukiswa kothisha, izinhlaka zocwaningo kanye nokufunda phakathi kwezikhungo ezahlukene. I-Design Institute iletha ulwazi olutholakale emazweni angu-26 nasezikhungweni ezingaphezu kuka-140, okuhlanganisa nezingu-7 e-Afrika.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Kwensika 5, ukuhlaziywa kwedatha nedatha yezinhlelo zemfundo nokuthathwa kwezinqumo, lolu bambiswano lukhombisa inhlangano yesifunda yemfundo ephakeme yakha amandla e-AI kumanyuvesi amaningi ngasikhathi sinye, uhlelo iWits AHEAD engalilinganisa nokufinyelela kwayo eNingizimu Afrika.

Inter-University Council for East Africa · Intergovernmental higher education body announcement

entry.title: Maharashtra sets up a state committee to govern AI and data dashboards across its universities
entry.summary:
UMnyango Wezemfundo Ephakeme Nobuchwepheshe waseMaharashtra e-India ukhiphe isinqumo sikahulumeni sokusungula iKomiti Yokubusa i-AI, Ukuhlaziywa Kwedatha Namabhodi Okubonisa Idatha, eholwa uSolwazi Rajnish Kamat, isekela likhansela leNyuvesi iShivaji, eKolhapur. Phakathi nesikhathi sawo seminyaka emithathu, ikomiti enamalungu ayisishiyagalolunye kufanele ibeke isu likahulumeni le-AI, ikhethe izinsebenziso ezibalulekile ze-AI ekhiqizayo, ukufunda komshini nokucutshungulwa kolimi lwemvelo, ihlanganise idatha kumabhodi asevele ekhona okubukisa ngabafundi, izivivinyo namabhesari, futhi yakhe uhlaziyo lwezimo oluzenzakalelayo kanye nokubikezela ubungozi kwisiteshi njengamanje esibika izibalo kuphela, ngenkathi ihlonipha imithetho yezokuphepha kwe-cyber neyobumfihlo. Ibika njalo ngekota kuzikhulu eziphezulu zoMnyango.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Kwensika 5, ukuhlaziywa kwedatha kwezinhlelo zemfundo nokwenza izinqumo, lokhu kungenye yezikhulu zohulumeni bezifundazwe okokuqala emhlabeni ukubeka ikomiti ehlala njalo futhi ezibophezele ekuguquleni ibhodi elibika izibalo kuphela libe uhlelo lwangempela lokuxwayisa kusenesikhathi nokusiza ekuthathweni kwezinqumo, isibonelo iWits AHEAD engasibiza uma imele lolo hlobo lwenguquko eNingizimu Afrika.

Government of Maharashtra, Higher and Technical Education Department · State government resolution, reported by regional press

entry.title: Telkom Foundation, BCX and Alibaba Cloud partner with Wits to give students AI-powered coding tools
entry.summary:
I-Telkom Foundation, i-BCX ne-Alibaba Cloud sebebambisene neNyuvesi yaseWitwatersrand ukunikeza cishe abafundi abangu-165 abakwibanga lesithathu kwezeSayensi Yekhompyutha ukufinyelela kwi-Qoder, inkundla yokuthuthukiswa kohlelo lwekhompyutha esekelwe ku-AI ye-Alibaba, ukuze bayisebenzise kumaphrojekthi abo emfundweni. Uhlelo lwe-Qoder luhloswe ngukunikeza abafundi ulwazi lwangempela lokusebenzisa amathuluzi wokubhala ikhodi asekelwe ku-AI ngaphambi kokuba bangene emsebenzini lapho la mathuluzi asengumthetho ojwayelekile khona, kanye nokuqinisa isixhumanisi phakathi kwesilabhasi saseWits nokwenzeka embonini yangempela. USolwazi Richard Klein, inhloko yeSikole seSayensi Yekhompyutha Nezibalo Ezisetshenziswayo eWits, uthe isilabhasi kudingeka siguquke silandele lezi zinguquko emhlabeni jikelele.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Kwensika 4, ikhono labathweswe iziqu, ukuqasheka nezinguquko ezinobulungiswa, lokhu kuyisinyathelo esisobala esithathwe iWits uqobo ukuvala igebe phakathi kwalokho abafundi bezesayensi yekhompyutha abakufundayo nemisebenzi yobunjiniyela bohlelo lwekhompyutha esiyeseleliwe ngamandla e-AI abazongena kuyo, ngezinga i-Wits AHEAD engalilandela futhi yakhe kulo.

Wits University · University announcement

entry.title: Systematic review of 124 studies finds AI's value in education depends on governance, not the technology, and flags a Global South research gap

category.term: Global (evidence base: Central Asia, East Africa)

entry.summary:
Ucwaningo oluhlaziya izifundo ngendlela ehlelekile, olwenziwe ochwepheshe basemanyuvesi aseKazakhstan, e-Uzbekistan naseTanzania, luhlanganise izifundo eziyi-124 ezishicilelwe phakathi kukaMasingana 2020 noMasingana 2026 mayelana nendlela i-AI eguqula ngayo imfundo. Lutholé ushintsho lwangempela kodwa olungalingani, kusuka ekusetshenzisweni kwamathuluzi e-AI ahlukene, kuya ekufundiseni okuvumelana nesimo futhi okusekelwe kudatha, futhi luphetha ngokuthi ukuthi lolu shintsho luyasiza noma luyalimaza abafundi kuncike ekubusweni nasesimweni sesikhungo, hhayi kwitheknoloji uqobo; ukwahlulela komuntu kanye nendima kathisha kufanele kuhlale kuyinto ephambili, kunokuthi i-AI iphathwe njengegunya elizimele. Ababhali baphinde bathola ukuthi ulwazi olusetshenzisiwe lucekele ngokuya ngokungangokwesiNgisi, kuyilapho imibono yaseNingizimu Yomhlaba, yabomdabu neyezilimi eziningi isengasekho.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Kwensika 6, i-AI enokuzibophezela, ukuziphatha okuhle, ukulingana nenqubomgomo, lokhu kuwukuqinisekiswa okushicilelwe ejenali ehlolwa ngontanga, okwenziwe ochwepheshe abasuka e-Central Asia naseMpumalanga Afrika, walelo gebe lolwazi elishukumisela umsebenzi kaWits AHEAD uqobo: uchwepheshe okufanele aqondise inqubomgomo ye-AI kwezemfundo awufaki ngokwanele imizwa yaseNingizimu Yomhlaba okufanele ayilalele.

entry.title: Business schools bring back oral defences as AI use rises
entry.summary:
Ezinye zezikhungo eziphambili zamabhizinisi eYurophu, phakathi kwazo i-Insead, i-Imperial College Business School ne-HEC Paris, zibuyisela ukuvivinywa ngomlomo, ukuhlolwa ngephepha nepeni kanye nokuhlolwa ngaphansi kokuqashwa okuqinile, ngoba i-AI ekhiqizayo isibuthakathaka ucwaningo lwecala oluvamile oluqedwa ekhaya. UPeter Todd, we-Imperial, uthi abafundisi abasenakuqiniseka ukuthi umsebenzi obhalwe uveza ini uma umfundi engawuvikeli ngomlomo noma engawubhali ngaphansi kokuqashwa; i-HEC Paris manje ihlanganisa ukuhlolwa 'ngaphandle komshini' 'nangomshini'. I-Graduate Management Admission Council ithi izinga lokuhlolwa kudingeka licace kakhulu ukuze iziqu zamabhizinisi zigcine ukubaluleka kwazo.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Kwensika 1, i-AI ekhiqizayo emfundweni ephakeme: ukufundisa, ukuhlolwa nobuqotho, ukubona izikhungo zamabhizinisi eziphambili zilahla ngokuphelele umsebenzi wasekhaya, kunokuwulungisa nje kancane, kuveza ngokusobala inselelo i-Wits AHEAD okumele ibhekane nayo ekugcineni ubuqotho bokuhlolwa emanyuvesi ase-Afrika abhekene nengcindezi efanayo, kodwa anezinsiza ezimbalwa kakhulu zokuhlela ukuhlolwa ngomlomo noma okuqashiwe.

entry.title: African curriculum experts meet in Dar es Salaam to confront the AI challenge in teacher education
entry.summary:
Ingqungquthela yesithupha ye-African Curriculum Association ibibanjelwe eDar es Salaam kusukela mhla zingama-22 kuya kwezingama-25 kuMandulo 2026, ihlanganisa abakhi bezifundo, abaqeqeshi bothisha, abacwaningi kanye nabenzi benqubomgomo abavela kulo lonke izwekazi. Umqondisi omkhulu we-Tanzania Institute of Education, uDkt Aneth Komba, kanye noNobhala Jikelele we-ACA, uDkt Gertrude Namubiru, bahole izingxoxo mayelana nendlela izifundo zase-Afrika nokuqeqeshwa kothisha okumele kuvumelane ne-AI nokushintsha kobuchwepheshe okusheshayo, kuyilapho kusagxile emakhonweni endawo nasezidingweni zemiphakathi. Ingqungquthela ihlose ukukhipha i-Dar es Salaam Declaration on Education Transformation in Africa, evumelana ne-Agenda 2063 ye-African Union kanye nomgomo wesine wentuthuko esimeme.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Kwensika 3, i-AI nokuhlaziywa kwedatha ku-STEM nasemfundweni yothisha, umhlangano wezwekazi ochaza indlela ukuqeqeshwa kothisha ngokwakho okumele kushintshe ngayo egunjini lokufunda elibunjwe yi-AI uhlangana ngokuqondile nomsebenzi we-Wits AHEAD wokuthi abaqeqeshi bothisha kudingeka bazini, hhayi kuphela ukuthi abafundi kufanele bafundiswe ini.

The Citizen (Tanzania) · Established national press

entry.title: Universities must teach people to work ‘with AI, not for AI’, says King's College London head
entry.summary:
Emhlanganweni i-2026 Korea Times Global Conference eSeoul, umqondisi omkhulu we-King's College London, uShitij Kapur, uthe amanyuvesi kumele aqinisekise ukuthi abantu basebenza ne-AI, hhayi ukuthi basebenzela yona. Ubeke izibopho ezinhlanu zamanyuvesi: ukuphinde achaze ukuthi ukufunda kusho ukuthini, ukulungiselela abathweswe iziqu imakethe yezemisebenzi eguqukayo, ukuvikela ucwaningo olucophelelayo, ukuqhuba i-AI ukuze isize wonke umuntu, kanye nokuqinisekisa ukuthi iqinisa amakhono abantu esikhundleni sokuwathatha. UKapur uthe indlela i-AI ekhula ngayo ayigcinwe, futhi amanyuvesi namazwe angakwazi ukubumba indlela eyakhiwa nesetshenziswa ngayo, kunokujwayela ukwamukela lokho okuvela emboni yobuchwepheshe.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Kwensika 6, i-AI enokuzibophezela, ukuziphatha okuhle, ukulingana nenqubomgomo, ukubona umqondisi omkhulu ophambili ebeka amanyuvesi enhliziyweni yokubumba i-AI kunokuvele asabele nje, kuqinisa isimo esifanayo se-Wits AHEAD: imfundo ephakeme eNingizimu Yomhlaba kumele isize ukubeka imithetho yokwamukelwa kwe-AI, hhayi ukwamukela nje amathuluzi enziwe kwenye indawo.

entry.title: Latin America's universities embrace AI faster than they can govern it, new study finds
entry.summary:
Ucwaningo lwe-UNESCO-IESALC olwenziwe ezikhungweni zemfundo ephakeme ezingu-200 emazweni angu-19 aseLatin America naseCaribbean luthole ukuthi amaphesenti angu-87 asesebenzisa i-AI kwenye ingxenye yomsebenzi wawo, kodwa amaphesenti angu-26 kuphela anohlaka olusemthethweni lwe-AI. Ukwamukelwa kuphakeme kakhulu emanyuvesini azimele angenzi nzuzo, ku-84%, kunama-68% asemphakathini kanye no-52% wamazimele enza inzuzo, kanti amaphesenti angu-55 ezikhungo awanabhajethi elizinikele ku-AI. UBorhene Chakroun we-UNESCO uthe ukukhulisa izinzuzo kuncike ekutshaleni izimali okuqhubekayo ekufinyeleleni nasemakhonweni, kanye nokubuswa okuqinisekisa ukusetshenziswa okunobuqotho, ukusobala nokubhekana nemiphumela.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Kwensika 6, i-AI enokuzibophezela, ukuziphatha okuhle, ukulingana nenqubomgomo, lolu cwaningo lukhombisa ngokuphelele ubungozi i-Wits AHEAD ekuxwayisa ngabo: amanyuvesi omphakathi, akhonza abafundi abanezinketho ezimbalwa kakhulu, ayamukela i-AI ngokushesha kunazo zonke emakilasini, kepha asemuva kakhulu ekubusweni, ekuqeqeshweni nasezimalini zokuyisebenzisa ngokunengqondo.

entry.title: African universities can drive talent development at scale, Mastercard Foundation tells Accra convening
entry.summary:
Emhlanganweni wokuqala we-Higher Education Transformation Convening e-Accra ngomhla ka-22 Mandulo 2026, uDkt John Nkengasong we-Mastercard Foundation uchaze amanyuvesi ase-Afrika 'njengezinjini zokuchuma' nengqalasizinda yamakhono abantu, okumele ahambisane nemakethe yabasebenzi nezimboni. Umcimbi uhloniphe izikhungo ezinhlanu ngomklomelo i-Africa Higher Education for Transformation (AHEFT): i-Addis Ababa University, i-2iE, i-Kwame Nkrumah University of Science and Technology, i-Muni University ne-University of Rwanda. Isisekelo siphinde sagcizelela umgomo waso wokusiza intsha yase-Afrika eyizigidi ezingu-30, amaphesenti angu-70 kuyo engabesifazane, ukuthola umsebenzi onesithunzi ngo-2030.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Kwensika 4, amakhono abaphothule iziqu, ukuqasheka nezinguquko ezinobulungiswa, ukubona umxhasi omkhulu ebeka amanyuvesi njengengqalasizinda yamathalente, ebuye abale i-AI njengamandla ashintsha umsebenzi, kuqinisa umsebenzi we-Wits AHEAD wokuthola ukuthi yimaphi amakhono abaphothule iziqu aholela ngempela emsebenzini onesithunzi ezimakethe zabasebenzi zase-Afrika.

entry.title: 'Syncopathy' and AI: African HE must choose verification
entry.summary:
Ebhala ku-University World News, uDkt Kende Kefale wase-University of Cape Town uqamba igama elithi 'syncopathy' ukuchaza imiphumela ye-AI, njengezingcaphuno nezimpikiswano, ebukeka ikholeka kodwa yeqa isinyathelo sokuqinisekisa, futhi uthi amanyuvesi analo leli phutha ngoba ukuhlola umsebenzi kuyabiza futhi akubonakali, kanti ukukhiqiza kushibhile futhi kulula ukukubala. Uphakamisa ukuthi izikhungo zidalule ukuthi ingakanani ingxenye yomsebenzi ehlolwa ngabantu ngaphambi kokunikezwa kweziqu, ukuthi uhlelo ngalunye lokuthola ngokuzenzakalelayo lube nomuntu oqanjwe ngegama obhekene namaphutha alo, nokuthi amarekhodi okuqinisekisa abe ngumphumela ohlala njalo wesikhungo. Ukhomba i-draft National AI Policy yaseNingizimu Afrika, eyahoxiswa ngoMbasa 2026 ngemuva kokutholakala kwezingcaphuno ezingekho ohlwini lwayo lwemithombo.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Kwensika 6, i-AI enokuzibophezela, ukuziphatha okulungile, ukulingana nenqubomgomo, lo mbono unikeza i-Wits AHEAD uhlaka olusebenzayo lokulawula i-AI emanyuvesi ase-Afrika, olubeka izindleko zokuqinisekisa nokuphendula ngezinqumo ezenziwa ngomshini ezikhungweni hhayi kubafundi.

entry.title: From AI use to funding cuts: how provosts are navigating 2026
entry.summary:
Ucwaningo luka-2026 lwe-Inside Higher Ed lwezikhulu zezemfundo ezingama-376 (ama-provost), olwenziwe yi-Hanover Research, luthola ukuthi cishe abayisikhombisa kwabayishumi basebenzisa i-AI emsebenzini wabo okungenani kanye ngesonto, kodwa oyedwa kuphela kwabayishumi uthi isikhungo sakhe sinesu le-AI elimaphakathi. Amaphesenti angu-12 kuphela abika ukuthuthuka kwendlela yokusebenza eminyangweni ngenxa yokutshalwa kwezimali ze-AI, amaphesenti angu-8 abika uguquko esikhungweni sonke, kanti amaphesenti angu-15 awakatshali lutho. Amakhono nomthamo wabasebenzi (amaphesenti angu-51) kanye nokumelana kwabafundisi nabasebenzi (amaphesenti angu-50) yizona zithiyo ezinkulu ezibaliwe.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Kwensika 5, ukuhlaziywa kwedatha nedatha yezinhlelo zemfundo nokwenza izinqumo, igebe phakathi kokusebenzisa kwabaholi i-AI bona uqobo kanye nesu lesikhungo yilona kanye lapho i-Wits AHEAD ikhuthaza khona izinqumo ezisekelwe ebufakazini ezingeni lohlelo mayelana ne-AI emanyuvesi.

entry.title: Record number of graduates pushes youth unemployment to 18.9%
entry.summary:
Ukungasebenzi kwentsha yasemadolobheni eneminyaka eyi-16 kuya kwengama-24 eShayina, ngaphandle kwabafundi, kukhuphuke kusuka kumaphesenti angu-17.9 ngoNtulikazi kwaya kumaphesenti angu-18.9 ngoNcwaba 2026, ngokwezibalo ze-National Bureau of Statistics ezibikwe yi-University World News. Lokhu kwenyuka kulandela inani eliyirekhodi labaphothule iziqu emanyuvesi abayizigidi ezingu-12.7 kuleli hlobo, futhi kuyizinga eliphezulu kunawo wonke selokhu kwashintshwa indlela yokubala ngo-2023. Umbiko ukhomba ukubuthaka kwesidingo sasekhaya nokwanda kokusetshenziswa kwe-AI njengengcindezi ekuqashweni kwabasaqalayo.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Kwensika 4, amakhono abaphothule iziqu, ukuqasheka nezinguquko ezinobulungiswa, isimo saseShayina sibonisa ukuthi ukwandisa imfundo ephakeme kukodwa akuqinisekisi umsebenzi uma i-AI ishintsha imisebenzi yabasaqalayo, isifundo i-Wits AHEAD ezosiqhathanisa nezimakethe zabasebenzi abaphothule iziqu eNingizimu Afrika naseNingizimu Yomhlaba.

entry.title: Ten-country African university alliance pushes joint research and AI skills
entry.summary:
I-Alliance for Africa Partnership, iqembu lezikhungo ezingu-12 emazweni ase-Afrika angu-10 elisekelwa yi-Michigan State University, lisebenzise umhlangano walo waminyaka yonke eDar es Salaam ngomhla ka-22 Mandulo 2026 ukubiza ucwaningo oluhlangene oluseduze kanye nokuthi amanyuvesi afake amakhono e-AI ezifundweni zawo. USolwazi Nelson Boniface wase-University of Dar es Salaam utshele izithunywa ukuthi ukwazi ukusebenzisa i-AI manje sekuyisidingo esiyisisekelo kubo bonke abathweswe iziqu, hhayi kuphela kulabo ababhala amakhodi, futhi wancenga ukuthi kube khona ukuxhumana okuqinile phakathi kwamanyuvesi, imboni nohulumeni ukuze ucwaningo luguqulelwe ekuxazululeni izinkinga ngokoqobo.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Insika 4 ihlanganisa i-AI, ikhono labathweswe iziqu, ukuqasheka nokuguquka okunobulungiswa. Umfelandawonye wamanyuvesi ase-Afrika osemazweni ayi-10 ofaka amakhono e-AI kanye nocwaningo oluhlangene ohlelweni lwawo, ungalindele izinhlaka zangaphandle, uyisibonelo esiphilayo sokubambisana phesheya kwemingcele i-Wits AHEAD ecwaninga ngakho, futhi kukhumbuza ukuthi igebe lamakhono lasezwekazini liyaxazululwa ngaphakathi.

entry.title: Report warns AI adoption in US colleges is outpacing student safeguards
entry.summary:
Umbiko omusha ohlelweni lwe-SHAPE lwe-Student Defense, obikwe yi-Inside Higher Ed ngomhla ka-18 Mandulo 2026, uthola ukuthi amakolishi ase-United States asefake i-AI ekwamukelweni kwabafundi, osizo lwezimali, ukwelulekwa nasekufundiseni ngokushesha ukwedlula indlela abakhe ngayo izivikelo zokuvikela abafundi. Ukhomba ukuchema kwe-alkhorithimu ezinqumweni zosizo, izikhala ekuvikelweni kwedatha, kanye nokulahlekelwa imiphakathi yokufunda yangempela njengezingozi eziyinhloko, futhi ubiza izikhungo ukuthi zibeke imithetho ecacile yokulawula nokusobala ngaphambi kokwandisa ukusetshenziswa kwezinhlelo ze-AI.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Kwensika 6, i-AI enokuzibophezela, ukuziphatha okulungile, ukulingana nenqubomgomo, lo mbiko uwuhlu oluqondile lokuthi kuphi lapho ukulawulwa kwe-AI kwimfundo ephakeme kusala emuva kunokwenzeka esikhathini sangempela, okusizayo ekuhloleni izinqubo zika-Wits AHEAD ngokusobala nokuphendula umphakathi mayelana nohlelo oluqhubeke kakhulu ekwamukeleni i-AI.

entry.title: UNESCO: over 25 education ministers declare AI must serve the 'common good'
entry.summary:
Onqumo bezemfundo abangaphezu kuka-25 kanye nezikhulu eziphezulu ababehlangene ku-Digital Learning Week ye-UNESCO eParis bamukele isitatimende esihlangene ngomhla ka-8 Mandulo 2026, sithi imfundo kufanele ihlale iyilungelo lomuntu nenzuzo evamile njengoba i-AI isakazeka emakilasini nasemanyuvesi. Isitatimende sibeka izinto eziyisishiyagalombili okumele zenziwe kuqala, kuhlanganise ukugcina izinhlelo ze-AI zingahlolwa futhi zibhekwe ngumphakathi, kanye nokuvikela izwi lothisha ngobuchwepheshe basekilasini. Sicaphuna ucwaningo lwe-UNESCO oluthola ukuthi amaphesenti angu-93 wongoti bemfundo ephakeme akholelwa ukuthi abafundi basebenzisa i-AI ekhiqizayo ukwenza imisebenzi yabo, futhi amaphesenti angu-63 abona ukwehla kwamakhono okucabanga abafundi.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Kwensika 6, i-AI enokuzibophezela, ukuziphatha okulungile, ukulingana nenqubomgomo, isitatimende sabaphathi bezemfundo esisezingeni elikhulu kanjena sinikeza i-Wits AHEAD isibonelo esamukelwa emhlabeni wonke sokuthi ukuphendulwa komphakathi kulawulo lwe-AI kufanele kubukeke kanjani, esingacashunwa ngqo amanyuvesi nabenzi benqubomgomo eNingizimu Yomhlaba.

entry.title: University of Alaska regents weigh a system-wide AI policy for every campus
entry.summary:
Ibhodi labaphathi be-University of Alaska libuyekeze uhlaka lwenqubomgomo ye-AI oluzocela wonke amakhampasi amathathu ukuba abe nohlelo lokusebenzisa i-AI kubafundi, abasebenzi nothisha. Uhlaka lubeka izimiso eziqondisayo mayelana nokugcinwa kokwahlulela komuntu, ukuvikelwa kobumfihlo nokuphepha kwedatha, kanye nokusetshenziswa kwe-AI ukwandisa ukufinyelela ezinsizeni zemfundo, kuhlelwe izigcawu zempendulo kuze kufike ekwindla ka-2026, ukugunyazwa kokugcina kuhlose ukuba semhlanganweni wababusi ka-Lwezi.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Insika 6 ihlanganisa i-AI enokuzibophezela, ukuziphatha okulungile, ukulingana kanye nezinqubomgomo. Uhlelo lwenyuvesi kahulumeni olwakha ukubusa kwalo kwe-AI kusukela ezimisweni eziyisisekelo, obala futhi lapho ababusi bebuza imibuzo ngamandla okuqapha, luyisibonelo esiwusizo sokubusa i-Wits AHEAD engalandela sona njengoba yakha izinqubomgomo zayo.

Alaska Public Media · Public broadcaster report

entry.title: World Bank opens free AI skills training to young people across 44 African countries
entry.summary:
I-World Bank isethule uhlelo i-'The Job I Hope For', imema intsha eneminyaka engu-18 kuya phezulu emazweni angu-44 ase-Afrika esezansi kweSahara ukuba ibhalise ohlelweni lokuqeqeshwa mahhala ku-inthanethi mayelana nezisekelo ze-AI ekhiqizayo, ukubhala imiyalo kanye nokuziphatha okulungile nge-AI, oluzofundiswa ngesiNgisi nangesiFulentshi ngoMfumfu 2026. Lolu hlelo luyaphendula ezweni elilindeleke ukuthi intsha engaphezu kwezigidi ezingu-600 ingene emakethe yezemisebenzi ngonyaka ka-2050, licela abahlanganyeli ukuthi baqale bachaze umsebenzi abawulangazelelayo ngaphambi kokwakha amakhono e-AI adingekayo ukuwufinyelela.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Insika 4 ihlanganisa i-AI, ikhono labathweswe iziqu, ukuqasheka nokuguquka okunobulungiswa. Uhlelo lwamakhono e-AI olumahhala nolusezingeni lonke lezwekazi, oluqondene ngqo nentsha engena emakethe yezemisebenzi, luwuhlolo oluqondile lokuthi ukuqeqeshwa okukhulu lungakhiwa kanjani emakethe zemisebenzi i-Wits AHEAD ecwaninga ngazo, futhi lungaba umlingani noma isibonelo okumele silandelwe.

World Bank · Intergovernmental body brief

entry.title: Systematic review finds AI training for future primary maths teachers is still too brief to stick
entry.summary:
Uphenyo oluhlelekile olwenziwe abacwaningi bamanyuvesi amathathu asePortugal luhlole izifundo ezingu-11 ezibuyekezwe ngontanga mayelana nendlela othisha abasafundela ukufundisa esikoleni samabanga aphansi abaqeqeshwa ngayo ukusebenzisa i-AI ekufundiseni izibalo. Iningi lokuqeqeshwa kwakuyizigcawu ezimfushane ezengezwe ezifundweni ezikhona kunokuba yizifundo ezinesikhathi eside, kuhlangothi kuqukethwe kahle ukuqwashisa nge-AI nokuyisebenzisa ngokuzwakalayo, kodwa kungahlangani ngokufanayo ukuziphatha okulungile nokuhlaziya ngokugxekayo, kushiya ubufakazi obuncane bokuthi lamakhono ayafinyelela ngempela emakilasini.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Insika 3 ihlanganisa i-AI nokuhlaziywa kwedatha ku-STEM nasemfundweni yothisha. Izici ezine ezibalulekile eziphawulwe uphenyo, ukuqwashiswa, ukwazi nokubhala imiyalo, ukuhlanganiswa kwezifundo, kanye nokuhlaziya ngokugxekayo, zinika i-Wits AHEAD uhlu oluqondile lokuklama umsebenzi wayo wokuqeqesha othisha, kunokuba kube umhlangano owodwa nje we-AI.

entry.title: New scale measures students' skill at using AI responsibly in assessed work
entry.summary:
Abacwaningi abavela ezikhungweni ezintathu eShayina baklame futhi baqinisekisa isikali esinezinto ezingu-18 esikala ukuthi abafundi bemfundo ephakeme bayiqonda kangakanani imigomo yokuhlola, badalule ukusetshenziswa kwe-AI futhi bagcine ubuqotho bezemfundo lapho besebenzisa i-AI ekhiqizayo emisebenzini yesikole. Kuhlolwe kubafundi abangu-486 kanye neqembu elihlukile labafundi abangu-798, isikali sabonisa isakhiwo esiqinile sezici ezinhlanu futhi sahlobana kakhulu nokubandakanyeka kwabafundi empendulweni abayitholayo kanye nenhloso yabo yokwenza ngobuqotho.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Insika 1 ihlanganisa i-AI ekhiqizayo ezemfundo ephakeme: ukufundisa, ukuhlola nobuqotho. Ithuluzi eliqinisekisiwe elifana nalel linika izikhungo indlela esebenzayo yokukala nokwakha ukwazi kwabafundi mayelana nokuhlolwa, kunokuncika kuphela kusofthiwe yokuthola noma imithetho evala konke.

Frontiers in Education · Peer-reviewed journal article

entry.title: Prescriptive AI model flags Ecuadorian students at highest dropout risk, and what would change it
entry.summary:
Abacwaningi enyuvesi yomphakathi eEcuador bakhe uhlaka lokuhlaziya oluphakamisa izinyathelo, olulandelela abafundi abangu-2 500 abangena phakathi kuka-2020 no-2024, oluqagela ubungozi bokuyeka isikole ngokunemba okuphezulu (ROC-AUC engu-0.95 kuya ku-0.97) futhi lukhomba noshintsho olulincane olungenzeka, njengesibonelo ukuphasa isikweletu sokufunda ngokushesha noma ukuthola i-inthanethi engcono ekhaya, okungasusa umfundi eqenjini elinobungozi obukhulu kunazo zonke. Amamaki onyaka wokuqala, inqubekelaphambili yesikweletu sokufunda esheshayo, ukuba sengcupheni ngokwezomnotho, nokufinyelela i-inthanethi ekhaya kwaba izona zibonakaliso eziqinile kunazo zonke.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Insika 2 ihlanganisa i-AI nokuhlaziya okubikezelayo ekuphumeleleni kwabafundi. Lokhu kuthuthukisa ukuhlaziya kwesixwayiso sokuqala kusuka ekuvele kukhombe abafundi abasengcupheni kuye ekuqagelweni kwezinyathelo ezithile, eziphansi ngezindleko, isibonelo i-Wits AHEAD engasibonisa ngaso emsebenzini wayo wokuphumelela kwabafundi ezindaweni ezinezinsizakusebenza ezifanayo.

Frontiers in Education · Peer-reviewed journal article

entry.title: Largest meta-analysis yet finds AI-supported STEM teaching has a real, moderate effect on learning
entry.summary:
Ucwaningo oluhlanganisa izifundo ezingu-35 ezilingiwe nezilingiswa luthole ukuthi ukufundisa okusekelwe yi-AI kunomthelela omuhle olilinganiselayo futhi obalulekile ngokwezibalo emiphumeleni yokufunda ku-STEM (g = 0.67). Inqubekelaphambili yayikhulu kakhulu kubafundi bezikole ezisezingeni eliphezulu, futhi izinhlelo ezithatha inyanga eyodwa kuya kwezimbili zaba yizona eziphumelele kakhulu kwalokho okuhlolwa.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Insika 3 ihlanganisa i-AI nokuhlaziywa kwedatha ku-STEM nasekufundisweni kothisha. Lolu ubufakazi obucacile kunazo zonke kuze kube manje bokuthi ukufundisa i-STEM okusekelwe yi-AI kuyasebenza ngempela, futhi ukutholakala ngobude besikhathi esihle sokungenelela kuwusizo ngqo endleleni i-Wits AHEAD eklama nehlela ngayo izinhlelo zayo ze-STEM.

Journal of Intelligence · Peer-reviewed meta-analysis

entry.title: Gates Foundation commits 1 billion US dollars over two years to equitable AI
entry.summary:
I-Gates Foundation izibophezele ukunikela okungenani izigidigidi eziyi-1 zamadola aseMelika kuminyaka emibili ezayo ukwakha nokuletha i-AI enobulungiswa obungcono, lapho izigidi ezingu-400 ziyiswa emfundweni, ezingu-400 kwezempilo, ezingu-100 kwezolimo kanti ezingu-100 zisiza ukwakha idatha yokuqeqesha i-AI ezilimini ezingasizakali ngokwanele. Lesi sibophezelo sihamba noMbiko wesi-10 iGoalkeepers wesikhungo, obizwa ngokuthi Make This Matter: AI, Equity and the Choice We Can't Delay.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Insika 6 ibuza ukuthi ubani owakha i-AI ngokuzibophezela, futhi kungobani. Isibophezelo sobuntu esikhulu kangaka, esihlose ukuvala igebe kumazwe ampofu kunawo wonke, sizoqondisa ukuthi yiziphi izinsiza ze-AI kwezemfundo ezizofinyelela emakilasini aseNingizimu Yomhlaba i-Wits AHEAD ewacwaningayo.

Gates Foundation · Foundation press release accompanying its Goalkeepers report

entry.title: Systematic review of 105 studies finds Africa and Oceania missing from generative AI teacher research
entry.summary:
Ucwaningo oluhlanganisiwe olulandela indlela ye-PRISMA, olubheka izifundo ezingu-105 ezihloliwe ngontanga mayelana nothisha ne-AI ekhiqizayo, ezishicilelwe kusukela ngo-2023 kuzincwadi ezikhulu zobuchwepheshe bemfundo, luthola ukuthi ucwaningo lugxile kakhulu eShayina, eTurkey, e-United States nase-Spain, kanti i-Afrika ne-Oceania azimelelwe ngokwanele. Ukwazi kwabathisha nge-AI, ulwazi lwabo lokufundisa kanye nokuzethemba, ngokwesakhiwo se-TPACK, kubikezela kangcono impumelelo yokusetshenziswa kwe-AI ekilasini kunokuvele babe nokufinyelela ezinsizeni.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Insika 3 ihlanganisa i-AI nokuhlaziywa kwedatha ku-STEM nasekufundisweni kothisha. Ucwaningo lolu bukhulu kangaka luqinisekisa ukuthi ucwaningo lwe-Wits AHEAD mayelana nemfundo yothisha base-Afrika luvala igebe elesaziwayo, hhayi ukuphinda umsebenzi osuvele wenziwe kakhulu.

Education Sciences (MDPI) · Peer-reviewed journal article

entry.title: Stanford study finds a persistent 19% AI employment gap for young workers
entry.summary:
I-Stanford Digital Economy Lab ibika ukuthi ukuqashwa kwabasha abaneminyaka engu-22 kuya kwengu-25 emisebenzini ethinteka kakhulu yi-AI manje kuphansi ngamaphesenti angu-19 kunalokho okwakulindelekile uma bekulingana nontanga babo abangathintekile kangako, kusuka kumaphesenti angu-15 onyaka odlule. Lo mehluko udalwa ikakhulukazi ukwehla kokuqashwa kwabasebenzi abasha, hhayi ukuxoshwa okwengeziwe, futhi uthinta kakhulu imisebenzi esekelwe olwazini olufundiswa ezincwadini, njengobunjiniyela bezinhlelo zekhompyutha nokusiza amakhasimende.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Insika 4 ibuza ukuthi i-AI iguqula kanjani indlela esuka eziqwini iye empilweni yansuku zonke. Lobu ubufakazi obucacile kunazo zonke kuze kube manje bokuthi imisebenzi yokuqala esekelwe olwazini incishiswa kuqala, okuqinisa isidingo somsebenzi wamakhono abathweswe iziqu ongagcini nje ngesiqu.

Stanford Digital Economy Lab · University research institute report

entry.title: New Global South framework sets conditions for responsible generative AI in teaching
entry.summary:
Ucwaningo lwebhibliyomethriki futhi oluhlelekile olushicilelwe ku-International Journal of Emerging Technologies in Learning lulandelela ukukhula okusheshayo kwemibhalo mayelana ne-AI ekhiqizayo enesibopho kwezokufundisa, futhi luphakamisa uhlaka lombono lwaseNingizimu Yomhlaba. Luthola ukuthi umkhiqizo wocwaningo uholwa yi-United States, iShayina ne-Australia, kanti kuhlonzwa ukuqwashisa ngokuziphatha, ukwethembana, ukwesekwa kwezikhungo, ukulungela kwengqalasizinda kanye nekhono le-AI njengezimo ezithinta kakhulu ukwamukelwa kwayo.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Insika 6 ihlanganisa i-AI enesibopho, ukuziphatha, ubulungiswa nenqubomgomo. Lolu hlaka lunikeza i-Wits AHEAD isisekelo esihloliwe ngontanga sokwahlulela ukuthi ukwamukelwa kwe-AI ekhiqizayo emanyuvesi aseNingizimu kunesibopho ngempela, hhayi nje ukuthi kuyatholakala.

International Journal of Emerging Technologies in Learning (iJET) · Peer-reviewed journal article

entry.title: PISA 2025 finds 15-year-olds who skip AI chatbots for schoolwork outscore those who rely on them, as global reading skills fall sharply
entry.summary:
Imiphumela ye-PISA 2025 ye-OECD, eyethulwe ngomhla ziyi-8 kuMandulo 2026, ibonisa ukuthi amamaki okufunda ehle ngamaphuzu angu-28 emazweni e-OECD nangamaphuzu angu-16 kwamanye amazwe namanani omnotho ahlanganyelayo phakathi kuka-2015 no-2025, okungenye yezinto ezehla kakhulu selokhu lolu hlolo lwaqala. Umbiko uthola ukuthi abafundi abaneminyaka engu-15 abangasebenzisi ama-chatbot e-AI emsebenzini wesikole ngokuvamile bathola amamaki aphakeme kunalabo abawasebenzisayo, futhi ngaphezu komunye kwabane wabafundi uthi omakhelwane bakhe bayaphazamiseka ngamadivayisi edijithali eziningi zezifundo zesayensi.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Isigxobo 5, ukuhlaziywa kwedatha nedatha yokusiza izinhlelo zemfundo nokuthatha izinqumo, sithola isibonakaliso esiqondile sohlelo lonke lapha: uhlolo lwezwe lonke oluxhumanisa ukuncika okuningi kuma-chatbot e-AI nemiphumela ebuthakathaka, isexwayiso i-Wits AHEAD esikuhlolisisa ngokuqondile mayelana nomsebenzi wayo wesigxobo 1 nge-AI ekhiqizayo ekufundiseni nasekuhloleni.

OECD (PISA 2025 Results, Volume I) · Intergovernmental body report

entry.title: Indian researchers show synthetic student data can train dropout early-warning systems without exposing real records
entry.summary:
Abacwaningi be-Parul University eNdiya, ababhala ejenali i-Scientific Reports ye-Nature, bakhe uhlelo lokufunda komshini oluqeqesha amamodeli wesexwayiso sangaphambili sokuyeka isikole ngedatha ye-abafundi eyenziwe ngokobuchwepheshe ngaphambi kokulungisa ngengxenye encane yedatha yangempela. Iqeqeshwe ngokugcwele ngabafundi abangu-20 000 abenziwe ngokobuchwepheshe kwizifundo ezingu-180, imodeli ikwazile ukubona ngokunembile amaphesenti angu-47.3 abafundi abasengozini ngesonto lesine, futhi yafinyelela isilinganiso sokunemba esingu-0.831 ngemuva kokulungiswa nge-ngxenye eyodwa kwezinhlanu yedatha yangempela, eduze nesilinganiso esingu-0.842 esatholakala ngokuqeqesha kuphela ngedatha yangempela.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Isigxobo 2, i-AI nokuhlaziya okubikezelayo empumelelweni yabafundi, sithola impendulo esebenzayo enkingeni yangempela: amanyuvesi angakwazi ukwabelana ngedatha ebucayi yabafundi angakwazi nokho ukwakha izinhlelo zesexwayiso sangaphambili ezithembekile mayelana nokuqhubeka, indlela i-Wits AHEAD engayilinganisa nomsebenzi wayo mayelana nokuqhubeka nokugcinwa kwabafundi.

Scientific Reports (Nature Portfolio) · Peer-reviewed journal article

entry.title: UNESCO-ICHEI dialogue in Kathmandu charts ethical, gender-inclusive AI integration for South Asian universities
entry.summary:
Ihhovisi le-UNESCO eKathmandu, i-Tribhuvan University, i-Asian Development Bank ne-UNESCO-ICHEI babuthanise abaholi bemfundo ephakeme nezikhulu zikahulumeni base-Asia eseNingizimu ngomhla zingama-20 kuNhlaba 2026 ukuze bahlele lokho inkulumo ka-Shafika Isaacs ekubize ngokuthi uhlelo lwe-AI oluhlanganisayo nolulungile. Ingxoxo ikhombe ingqalasizinda yedijithali engalingani, amakhono e-AI alinganiselwe kubafundisi, kanye nezinqubomgomo zamazwe ezingaxhumene njengezithiyo eziyinhloko zesifunda, futhi yethula isikhungo sikazwelonke se-ICHEI eNepal e-Tribhuvan University sokwakha amakhono e-AI, futhi yandulela umbiko ozayo mayelana noguquko lwedijithali kwimfundo ephakeme ye-Asia eseNingizimu.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Isigxobo 6, i-AI enokuzibophezela, ukuziphatha okuhle, ukulingana nezinqubomgomo, kanye nesigxobo 3, i-AI kwimfundo yesayensi neyothisha, kokubili kuvela ngokuqondile lapha: isikhungo sesifunda sokwakha amakhono kanye nesibopho esiqanjiwe sokubandakanywa ngokugcwele kwamantombazane nabesifazane ezifundweni nemisebenzini ehlobene ne-AI kunikeza isibonelo i-Wits AHEAD engasilinganisa nezikhala zayo zezinqubomgomo eNingizimu Afrika.

UNESCO · UN agency article
